payload.explanation: The diagnostic report identifies LOCK_CONTENTION: the business request (session_488853780735) waits on a lock chain rooted at session_f4df9058f5f0, an idle-in-transaction session whose last statement was an UPDATE on inventory. The state report confirms session_f4df9058f5f0 is eligible for rollback_session under current policy, while the intermediate waiter session_f98a163fda65 has no allowed actions. Rolling back the upstream root blocker releases the lock chain so the business request can complete and stock reaches 199; the business request itself must not be modified directly. Missing pg_locks evidence is absence of direct confirmation, not disproof.
